name: Uzziah
summary: A king of Judah, also called Azariah, who began to reign at sixteen and grew strong while he looked to God. When pride led him to burn incense in the temple, he became a leper until he died.

key_moments.title: Made King at Sixteen
key_moments.description: Judah's people made Uzziah king at sixteen, and he ruled from Jerusalem for fifty-two years. While he looked to God, God gave him success.

key_moments.title: Grows Strong with God's Help
key_moments.description: God helped Uzziah fight the Philistines, and his fame spread as far as Egypt. He fortified Jerusalem with towers and fitted them with machines to shoot arrows and large stones.

key_moments.title: Struck with Leprosy in the Temple
key_moments.description: Proud of his strength, Uzziah entered the temple to burn incense, which only the priests were to do. While he raged at the priests, leprosy broke out on his forehead, and he lived apart as a leper until he died.
